jobs.title: Chief Executive Officer
jobs.description:
Our Client is a US climate technology company
tackling one of the world's toughest climate challenges: decarbonizing cement - an industry responsible for ~8% of global CO₂ emissions. Their breakthrough is a non-thermal activation process that produces cement at room temperature, performance-equivalent to traditional OPC, at or below cost, without the high-temperature kilns that make cement emissions-intensive. They have validated their material science at kilogram scale (TRL ~5) and are now scaling to "multi-tonne per day" demonstration. Their technology is a drop-in solution designed to integrate seamlessly into existing cement plants with industry partners worldwide. They are seeking a Founder-Operator CEO
who has led BOTH capital formation and technology deployment AND plant integration on the same projects
, to drive this next critical phase of their journey.

Position : Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
Capital Formation | Technology Integration & Deployment | Founder-Operator Leadership
Location: Los Angeles, CA, USA

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a hands-on, action-oriented CEO role responsible for leading our client through its next phase of growth: securing the capital required for commercial-scale deployment
, building the organization, and delivering the first "multi-tonne per day" demonstration systems that will integrate into partner cement plants globally. You will bring dual capability: (1) Capital Formation
- personally originating, leading, negotiating, and closing venture and institutional capital to fund the company's growth; and (2) Brownfield Technology Integration & Deployment
- leading the integration of a novel technology into existing industrial operations, from development through commissioning, ensuring it works reliably within a partner's existing plant infrastructure. Rather than a pure corporate CEO or a pure technology founder, you will be a Founder-Operator
who combines capital-raising capability with hands-on execution.
You will operate with significant autonomy, building the organization from the ground up,
while working closely with the founder and board on strategic direction.

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE UNIQUE:

Founder-Operator Mandate:
You will lead both capital formation and technology deployment or plant integration on the same projects - not across separate roles.
Brownfield Drop-In Integration:
You will deploy a novel technology within operational cement plants - navigating plant interfaces, working within operational constraints, and managing deployment with minimal disruption.
Hands-On Deployment:
You will be boots-on-the-ground - physically present at partner plants during critical integration and commissioning phases, working directly with our customers: cement plant operators, engineering teams, and concrete contractors.
First-of-a-Kind Deployment:
You will deliver a novel non-thermal cement process at commercial scale, deployed within partner operations, setting the foundation for future commercial replication.
Dual Accountability:
You will own both capital deployment and technology delivery – not just one or the other.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Capital Formation & Fundraising (Primary Focus ~50%)

Personally originate, lead, negotiate, and raise capital.

Lead the fundraising strategy for Series B and project-level financing.
Structure and negotiate project-level capital stacks.
Raise capital from sovereign wealth funds, development finance institutions (DFIs), institutional investors, and venture capital.
Secure offtake agreements for low-carbon environmental commodities.
Secure committed capital and commercial customers - not just support or participation.

Brownfield Technology Integration & Deployment (Critical ~30%)

Lead the integration of the novel process into partner cement plants, overseeing design, engineering, and commissioning within existing plant infrastructure.
Manage interfaces with plant operations, EPC contractors, equipment vendors, and engineering partners to ensure seamless integration and operational continuity.
Resolve deployment-phase issues including technical challenges, supply chain disruptions, contractor performance, and plant integration.
Take full accountability for project timelines, budgets, risk management, safety, quality, and operational readiness.
Drive cost reduction and process optimization throughout deployment.

Organization Building & Leadership (~10%)

Recruit, build, and lead the executive and operational teams.
Establish company culture, processes, and governance.
Manage P&L and operational budgets.
Build systems for repeatable execution across multiple partner locations.

Stakeholder & Partnership Engagement (~10%)

Serve as the primary interface with governments, regulators, and industry partners.
Build and maintain relationships with global cement partners.
Represent the company to investors, partners, and regulatory bodies.
Navigate complex multi-stakeholder environments

REQUIREMENTS :

Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering,
or a related engineering discipline.
An MBA or advanced degree in Business or Finance
is highly advantageous.
Demonstrated executive leadership experience, preferably as CEO, MD, or Country leadership.
Proven track record as a Founder-Operator who has successfully executed BOTH
capital formation AND
technology deployment . Candidates with expertise in only one area may not be a fit:

Capital Formation:
Originating, leading, negotiating, and closing institutional capital (equity and debt) from sovereign wealth funds, DFIs, institutional investors, or venture capital.
Brownfield Technology Integration & Deployment:
Personally leading project - deploying new technology into an existing operational plant - full lifecycle from development through integration, commissioning, and operations start-up, with direct, on-site involvement.
Project size typically USD 10M–100 million+
.
Strong understanding of project economics, capital structuring, and infrastructure financial models
.
Experience navigating government, regulatory, and multi-stakeholder environments
.
Experience managing P&L and operational budgets
.
Demonstrated ability to operate as a peer to founders, board members, and C-suite executives to represent the company at the highest levels - with partners, investors, and regulatory bodies.
Ability to command respect and build trust in high-stakes, multi-stakeholder environments.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing capabilities.
Proven track record of engaging and influencing sovereign wealth funds, DFIs, institutional investors, and government leaders with confidence and credibility.
Proven ability to build and lead high-performing executive and operational teams.
Strong commercial acumen with experience managing multi-million-dollar budgets.
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, resource-constrained startup environment.
Willingness to be hands-on and boots-on-the-ground - spending significant time at partner cement plants and project sites to oversee integration, troubleshoot issues, and ensure successful deployment.

HIGHLY ADVANTAGEOUS:

Background in energy infrastructure, utilities, or industrial sectors.
Exposure to carbon markets, carbon credits, or energy transition projects.
Experience in investment, M&A, or strategy, only
where combined with direct infrastructure execution and capital raising.

Experience with cement, lime, or minerals processing industries.
Experience working internationally with multiple global partners.
Prior experience in a Founder-Operator capacity.

Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

jobs.title: Residential Program Director - Adult Residential Services
jobs.description:
Job Details

Description

Director of Adult Residential Services

Annual Salary:
$110,000-$125,000/year

Make a Real Difference Every Day:
Do you want a career where you directly impact lives, experiencing the deep fulfillment that comes from helping others and a strong sense of purpose?

About DDI:
For nearly 65 years, DDI (Developmental Disabilities Institute) has been a leading agency providing a full spectrum of care for over 1,600 children and adults with autism and other developmental disabilities. We are driven by a dedicated team and a deep belief in the potential of every individual.

The Role:
DDI’s Residential Director is responsible for all program oversight for their assigned caseload. You will work closely with your management team and DDI Administration to ensure that your programs are providing high quality and meaningful supports to your residents. Our ideal candidate has at least 5 years of advanced leadership experience in an OPWDD program and a Bachelor’s Degree in a Human Services field.

What You'll Do

Oversee all program operations of the agency’s adult residential programs, including Day Hab for 24-hour program models.
Be responsible for the hiring and management of sufficient staff to carry out the programs’ objectives.
Ensure adequate training is provided for staff which results in excellent employee competencies.
Be responsible for developing annual budgets for each program service and for managing the fiscal status of each to ensure budgetary goals are achieved.
Assure high quality services (which exceed governmental regulations) are provided and that programs develop and implement quality improvement plans.
Ensure all program services maintain compliance with all applicable regulations and necessary governmental certifications.
Ensure the dignity, respect and rights of individuals served are maintained at all times.
Ensure people served as well as employees of the programs are provided with a safe environment.
Be responsible for the development of new programmatic services and options to meet the changing needs of individuals and their families.
Provide necessary training for management staff in the department.
Work collaboratively and cooperatively with other departments in the agency.
Maintain positive professional relationships with other agencies and governing entities.
Ensure positive and sufficient communication with families of people served by the department.
Serve as a contributing member of the agency’s senior management team.
Participate in designated agency committees as assigned, i.e. Incident Review.
Ensure all incidents are handled, reported & documented appropriately.
Perform other job-related duties as required.

What You Need For The Role

Bachelor’s Degree in related human service field required; Master’s Degree preferred.
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in advanced management level experience in work related to providing high quality services to adults with developmental disabilities.
NYS Driver’s License

Why You'll Love This Job

Build Meaningful Relationships: Develop strong connections with the people DDI supports, their families and other stakeholders.
Learn and Grow: Benefit from ongoing training and professional development.
Be Part of a Supportive Team: Work with passionate and dedicated colleagues.
Experience Job Satisfaction: Feel a deep sense of accomplishment knowing your work matters.

Here’s How We Support You

Comprehensive Paid Training: Get the skills you need to succeed.
Exceptional Benefits: Including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, FSA, and EAP.
Retirement Security: 403(b) retirement plan.
Invest in Your Future: Tuition reimbursement opportunities.
Career Growth: Opportunities for advancement within DDI.
Paid Time Off: Enjoy generous paid time off: 20 vacation days, 3 personal days, 3 floating holidays 12 sick days and paid agency holidays.
And More: Numerous other valuable benefits also!

If You Are

Empathic, compassionate, and patient
Positive, energetic, and enthusiastic
A good communicator and team player
Passionate about making a difference

Then, we encourage you to apply and join the DDI team!

When you join our team, you become part of the DDI Family! Click here to watch our video to find out more about the DDI Family.

jobs.title: Director of Major Gifts
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Major Gifts based in the United States.

This is a senior fundraising leadership role focused on building and expanding a major gifts program from the ground up. You will lead the acquisition, qualification, cultivation, and solicitation of high-net-worth donors, with a strong emphasis on developing new relationships. Working closely with executive leadership, Board members, and development teams, you will help unlock significant untapped philanthropic potential. The role combines frontline fundraising with strategy, team leadership, pipeline development, and donor engagement. You will manage a substantial personal portfolio while building systems that make prospecting and moves management scalable. Success will be measured by new donor acquisition, major gift revenue, pipeline growth, and the development of a more diversified individual giving program.

Accountabilities

Source, qualify, cultivate, and convert new major donors at the $10K+ level, personally managing relationships from initial discovery through solicitation and close.
Build and maintain a disciplined prospecting engine using wealth screening, Board and peer referrals, network mapping, event follow-up, donor-advised fund and family foundation research, and annual or mid-level donor upgrades.
Develop re-engagement strategies for lapsed and dormant donors and identify opportunities to increase giving among existing supporters with untapped capacity.
Manage a personal portfolio of high-net-worth donors and prospects, securing six- and seven-figure commitments through tailored solicitation strategies.
Partner with senior revenue leadership to establish and maintain clear qualification standards, including donor visits, pipeline velocity, moves management, and acquisition targets.
Represent the organization externally with credibility and authenticity, communicating its mission, programs, results, and broader impact to sophisticated philanthropic audiences.
Lead the major gifts and individual giving program across strategy, prospect development, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.
Collaborate with annual giving and stewardship leaders to create a coherent donor journey from first contribution through transformational giving.
Build, supervise, and coach frontline fundraising and donor engagement staff, fostering a culture focused on pipeline development and new relationship acquisition.
Work closely with Development Operations to strengthen Salesforce, pipeline reporting, forecasting, prospect research, and relationship-management processes.
Collaborate with the CEO, Board, Finance, Communications, and Program teams to expand philanthropic networks and align fundraising priorities with organizational impact.
Partner on donor stewardship, recognition, events, briefings, and campaigns designed to create meaningful engagement and additional qualification opportunities.
During the first 90 days, assess the existing pipeline, evaluate prospects above $10K, develop a qualification plan for 40 new prospects, complete an initial 20 discovery visits, and establish a multi-year individual giving growth plan.
Within the first 12 months, target approximately $2M in personally closed revenue from a portfolio of 100–125 households, with at least 70% expected to come from new major-gift donors, while moving 20 new prospects into active cultivation and securing 10 six-figure commitments.
Help build a repeatable qualification and prospect management engine that can continue operating effectively as the fundraising program scales.
Work toward long-term individual giving growth from approximately $2M to $10M, supported by a more diversified donor base and a documented seven-figure prospect pipeline.

Requirements

10+ years of experience in nonprofit fundraising or comparable relationship-based revenue work, including at least 5 years focused on major or individual giving.
Demonstrated success acquiring new major donors rather than primarily managing inherited portfolios, with the ability to explain how relationships were personally sourced, cultivated, and closed.
Proven experience personally closing gifts at the six-figure level, with seven-figure fundraising experience or a credible path to achieving it.
Experience building a major gifts pipeline from a limited prospect base, including prospect identification, qualification, moves management, and portfolio development.
Demonstrated experience managing, developing, and coaching frontline fundraisers, with evidence of improved team performance.
Strong command of CRM-driven pipeline management and data-informed portfolio decisions; Salesforce NPSP experience is preferred.
Ability to build trust and communicate effectively with high-net-worth individuals, executives, Board members, and other sophisticated stakeholders.
Strong strategic judgment, relationship-building skills, and the ability to move prospects from initial engagement through major gift solicitation.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to connect donor motivations to measurable program and policy impact.
Genuine interest in work focused on immigration, economic mobility, workforce inclusion, or related social-impact issues, with the ability to discuss these topics thoughtfully and respectfully.
Campaign fundraising experience, particularly during a quiet phase, is helpful but not required.
Existing networks within technology, finance, immigrant-serving philanthropy, or family foundations are advantageous.
Lived or professional experience related to immigration, resettlement, or workforce development is helpful.
Candidates are evaluated primarily on demonstrated fundraising results and acquisition experience rather than credentials alone.

Benefits

Salary of $135,000–$145,000, depending on experience.
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance.
401(k) with employer match.
160 hours of paid time off.
72 hours of sick leave.
16 hours of health and wellness time.
Birthday PTO.
Organization-wide paid closure from December 24 through January 1.
12 weeks of gender-inclusive paid parental leave.
Dedicated travel and donor cultivation budget.
Access to prospect research and wealth-screening tools.
Active support from executive leadership and Board members for donor meetings.
Remote position within the United States.
Approximately 30% travel expected.
Full-time, exempt position.

How Jobgether Works

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. jobs.title: Director of Development & Production, Digital Programming
jobs.description:
The Director of Development & Production is a senior creative leader responsible for the development, production, and execution of premium digital-first content across Lifestyle, Food & Travel, and Entertainment. This role oversees content from concept through delivery while driving creative innovation, production excellence, and audience growth across YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and emerging digital platforms.

The ideal candidate is an experienced creative producer with a passion for storytelling, a proven ability to develop original franchises and recurring series, and an enthusiasm for Food, Travel, and Entertainment programming. They understand how to create compelling, platform-native content that grows audiences, attracts brand partners, and elevates an established media brand.

Working closely with executive leadership, editorial, audience development, and sales teams, the Director of Development & Production will lead creative development, oversee production operations, mentor production teams, and ensure every project meets the highest editorial and production standards.

Responsibilities

Creative Development & Strategy

Lead the creative development of original digital series, recurring franchises, specials, and branded content initiatives for growing digital editorial brands including @AmazingAmericaTV and @PauseRewind.
Identify emerging audience trends, platform opportunities, and storytelling formats that support audience growth and business objectives.
Generate, pitch, and develop new programming concepts while evolving existing series with fresh creative approaches.
Create series treatments, story outlines, mood boards, production decks, and presentation materials for internal stakeholders and external partners.
Partner with leadership to build and maintain a robust content development pipeline aligned with editorial priorities and commercial opportunities.

Production Leadership

Oversee all productions from greenlight through final delivery across multiple platforms and formats.
Direct studio and field productions, providing clear creative vision to crews, producers, editors, and on-camera talent.
Manage creative execution throughout pre-production, production, post-production, and final approval.
Review and approve creative materials including treatments, scripts, casting recommendations, production schedules, budgets, graphics, music, rough cuts, fine cuts, and final deliverables.
Establish production workflows and best practices that improve efficiency while maintaining exceptional creative quality.

Team Leadership

Mentor producers, coordinators, freelance talent, editors, and production partners.
Foster a collaborative, creative culture focused on innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Manage multiple concurrent productions while balancing priorities, deadlines, budgets, and available resources.
Facilitate creative brainstorms with Editorial, Audience Development, and Sales teams to maximize content performance.

Audience Growth & Optimization

Collaborate with Audience Development and Analytics teams to leverage performance insights and optimize future content.
Maintain a deep understanding of platform algorithms, viewer behavior, and evolving digital consumption habits.
Champion experimentation with new storytelling techniques, production technologies, creators, and distribution strategies.

Brand Partnerships & Business Development

Work closely with branded content and sales teams to develop premium sponsorship opportunities that seamlessly integrate advertiser objectives while maintaining editorial integrity.
Cultivate relationships within the tourism, hospitality, culinary, lifestyle, and entertainment industries to identify new content and partnership opportunities.
Represent the company during partner meetings, industry events, production shoots, and creative presentations.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Film, Television, Digital Media, Marketing, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
7+ years of experience developing and producing original digital content for major media brands, publishers, production companies, or digital platforms.
Demonstrated leadership experience managing creative production teams and overseeing multiple concurrent productions.
Professional experience and genuine enthusiasm for creating Lifestyle, Food & Travel, and Entertainment content.
Proven success developing and launching original digital video series that drive audience engagement and growth.
Extensive experience overseeing productions from concept through post-production across YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, FAST, streaming, and emerging platforms.
Strong creative judgment with experience providing feedback across every stage of development, production, and editorial review.
Experience directing both studio and field productions, working with talent, creators, celebrities, and non-professional hosts.
Strong understanding of branded content, sponsorship integrations, and advertiser collaboration.
Exceptional organizational, communication, and project management skills.

Preferred

Experience developing creator-led programming and influencer collaborations.
Familiarity with production management software, digital asset management systems, and content performance analytics.
Experience managing production budgets, vendor negotiations, and resource planning.

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

jobs.title: Director of Operations
jobs.description:
Company Description
Tolbert Realty LLC is a real estate company focused on providing reliable, client-centered property services in a dynamic and competitive market. The organization emphasizes transparency, responsiveness, and long-term relationships with clients and partners. Team members collaborate to streamline processes, improve service quality, and support sustainable growth. Tolbert Realty LLC values professionalism, accountability, and continuous improvement, offering opportunities to contribute meaningfully to operational and strategic initiatives.
Role Description
The Director of Operations at Tolbert Realty LLC is a full-time, remote role responsible for overseeing daily business operations and ensuring efficient, consistent workflows across the organization. This position manages operational processes, develops and implements policies, and monitors performance metrics to support business goals and regulatory compliance. The Director of Operations will coordinate cross-functional teams, optimize resource allocation, and collaborate with leadership on strategic planning, budgeting, and forecasting. Day-to-day responsibilities include supervising team performance, resolving operational issues, improving customer service practices, and identifying opportunities for process enhancements and cost savings. The role also involves maintaining documentation, supporting technology and system adoption, and fostering a culture of accountability, communication, and continuous improvement.
Qualifications

Strong Operations Management skills, including experience designing, implementing, and refining processes to improve efficiency and scalability.
Demonstrated Analytical Skills to interpret data, track key performance indicators, and drive data-informed decisions.
Proven Team Management abilities, including leading remote teams, coaching staff, and managing cross-functional collaboration.
Experience with Budgeting, financial oversight, and cost control to support sustainable growth and operational stability.
Commitment to high-quality Customer Service, with the ability to support client-focused standards and resolve escalated issues.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong organizational and time management capabilities.
Proficiency with common business software, collaboration tools, and basic CRM or real estate platforms.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations Management, or a related field; equivalent experience in operations leadership may be considered.
Prior experience in real estate, property management, or a service-oriented business environment is preferred.

new_jobs.description:
Job Details

Description

Director of Adult Residential Services

Annual Salary:
$110,000-$125,000/year

Make a Real Difference Every Day:
Do you want a career where you directly impact lives, experiencing the deep fulfillment that comes from helping others and a strong sense of purpose?

About DDI:
For nearly 65 years, DDI (Developmental Disabilities Institute) has been a leading agency providing a full spectrum of care for over 1,600 children and adults with autism and other developmental disabilities. We are driven by a dedicated team and a deep belief in the potential of every individual.

The Role:
DDI’s Residential Director is responsible for all program oversight for their assigned caseload. You will work closely with your management team and DDI Administration to ensure that your programs are providing high quality and meaningful supports to your residents. Our ideal candidate has at least 5 years of advanced leadership experience in an OPWDD program and a Bachelor’s Degree in a Human Services field.

What You'll Do

Oversee all program operations of the agency’s adult residential programs, including Day Hab for 24-hour program models.
Be responsible for the hiring and management of sufficient staff to carry out the programs’ objectives.
Ensure adequate training is provided for staff which results in excellent employee competencies.
Be responsible for developing annual budgets for each program service and for managing the fiscal status of each to ensure budgetary goals are achieved.
Assure high quality services (which exceed governmental regulations) are provided and that programs develop and implement quality improvement plans.
Ensure all program services maintain compliance with all applicable regulations and necessary governmental certifications.
Ensure the dignity, respect and rights of individuals served are maintained at all times.
Ensure people served as well as employees of the programs are provided with a safe environment.
Be responsible for the development of new programmatic services and options to meet the changing needs of individuals and their families.
Provide necessary training for management staff in the department.
Work collaboratively and cooperatively with other departments in the agency.
Maintain positive professional relationships with other agencies and governing entities.
Ensure positive and sufficient communication with families of people served by the department.
Serve as a contributing member of the agency’s senior management team.
Participate in designated agency committees as assigned, i.e. Incident Review.
Ensure all incidents are handled, reported & documented appropriately.
Perform other job-related duties as required.

What You Need For The Role

Bachelor’s Degree in related human service field required; Master’s Degree preferred.
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in advanced management level experience in work related to providing high quality services to adults with developmental disabilities.
NYS Driver’s License

Why You'll Love This Job

Build Meaningful Relationships: Develop strong connections with the people DDI supports, their families and other stakeholders.
Learn and Grow: Benefit from ongoing training and professional development.
Be Part of a Supportive Team: Work with passionate and dedicated colleagues.
Experience Job Satisfaction: Feel a deep sense of accomplishment knowing your work matters.

Here’s How We Support You

Comprehensive Paid Training: Get the skills you need to succeed.
Exceptional Benefits: Including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, FSA, and EAP.
Retirement Security: 403(b) retirement plan.
Invest in Your Future: Tuition reimbursement opportunities.
Career Growth: Opportunities for advancement within DDI.
Paid Time Off: Enjoy generous paid time off: 20 vacation days, 3 personal days, 3 floating holidays 12 sick days and paid agency holidays.
And More: Numerous other valuable benefits also!

If You Are

Empathic, compassionate, and patient
Positive, energetic, and enthusiastic
A good communicator and team player
Passionate about making a difference

Then, we encourage you to apply and join the DDI team!

When you join our team, you become part of the DDI Family! Click here to watch our video to find out more about the DDI Family.

new_jobs.title: Director of Major Gifts
new_jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Major Gifts based in the United States.

This is a senior fundraising leadership role focused on building and expanding a major gifts program from the ground up. You will lead the acquisition, qualification, cultivation, and solicitation of high-net-worth donors, with a strong emphasis on developing new relationships. Working closely with executive leadership, Board members, and development teams, you will help unlock significant untapped philanthropic potential. The role combines frontline fundraising with strategy, team leadership, pipeline development, and donor engagement. You will manage a substantial personal portfolio while building systems that make prospecting and moves management scalable. Success will be measured by new donor acquisition, major gift revenue, pipeline growth, and the development of a more diversified individual giving program.

Accountabilities

Source, qualify, cultivate, and convert new major donors at the $10K+ level, personally managing relationships from initial discovery through solicitation and close.
Build and maintain a disciplined prospecting engine using wealth screening, Board and peer referrals, network mapping, event follow-up, donor-advised fund and family foundation research, and annual or mid-level donor upgrades.
Develop re-engagement strategies for lapsed and dormant donors and identify opportunities to increase giving among existing supporters with untapped capacity.
Manage a personal portfolio of high-net-worth donors and prospects, securing six- and seven-figure commitments through tailored solicitation strategies.
Partner with senior revenue leadership to establish and maintain clear qualification standards, including donor visits, pipeline velocity, moves management, and acquisition targets.
Represent the organization externally with credibility and authenticity, communicating its mission, programs, results, and broader impact to sophisticated philanthropic audiences.
Lead the major gifts and individual giving program across strategy, prospect development, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.
Collaborate with annual giving and stewardship leaders to create a coherent donor journey from first contribution through transformational giving.
Build, supervise, and coach frontline fundraising and donor engagement staff, fostering a culture focused on pipeline development and new relationship acquisition.
Work closely with Development Operations to strengthen Salesforce, pipeline reporting, forecasting, prospect research, and relationship-management processes.
Collaborate with the CEO, Board, Finance, Communications, and Program teams to expand philanthropic networks and align fundraising priorities with organizational impact.
Partner on donor stewardship, recognition, events, briefings, and campaigns designed to create meaningful engagement and additional qualification opportunities.
During the first 90 days, assess the existing pipeline, evaluate prospects above $10K, develop a qualification plan for 40 new prospects, complete an initial 20 discovery visits, and establish a multi-year individual giving growth plan.
Within the first 12 months, target approximately $2M in personally closed revenue from a portfolio of 100–125 households, with at least 70% expected to come from new major-gift donors, while moving 20 new prospects into active cultivation and securing 10 six-figure commitments.
Help build a repeatable qualification and prospect management engine that can continue operating effectively as the fundraising program scales.
Work toward long-term individual giving growth from approximately $2M to $10M, supported by a more diversified donor base and a documented seven-figure prospect pipeline.

Requirements

10+ years of experience in nonprofit fundraising or comparable relationship-based revenue work, including at least 5 years focused on major or individual giving.
Demonstrated success acquiring new major donors rather than primarily managing inherited portfolios, with the ability to explain how relationships were personally sourced, cultivated, and closed.
Proven experience personally closing gifts at the six-figure level, with seven-figure fundraising experience or a credible path to achieving it.
Experience building a major gifts pipeline from a limited prospect base, including prospect identification, qualification, moves management, and portfolio development.
Demonstrated experience managing, developing, and coaching frontline fundraisers, with evidence of improved team performance.
Strong command of CRM-driven pipeline management and data-informed portfolio decisions; Salesforce NPSP experience is preferred.
Ability to build trust and communicate effectively with high-net-worth individuals, executives, Board members, and other sophisticated stakeholders.
Strong strategic judgment, relationship-building skills, and the ability to move prospects from initial engagement through major gift solicitation.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to connect donor motivations to measurable program and policy impact.
Genuine interest in work focused on immigration, economic mobility, workforce inclusion, or related social-impact issues, with the ability to discuss these topics thoughtfully and respectfully.
Campaign fundraising experience, particularly during a quiet phase, is helpful but not required.
Existing networks within technology, finance, immigrant-serving philanthropy, or family foundations are advantageous.
Lived or professional experience related to immigration, resettlement, or workforce development is helpful.
Candidates are evaluated primarily on demonstrated fundraising results and acquisition experience rather than credentials alone.

Benefits

Salary of $135,000–$145,000, depending on experience.
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance.
401(k) with employer match.
160 hours of paid time off.
72 hours of sick leave.
16 hours of health and wellness time.
Birthday PTO.
Organization-wide paid closure from December 24 through January 1.
12 weeks of gender-inclusive paid parental leave.
Dedicated travel and donor cultivation budget.
Access to prospect research and wealth-screening tools.
Active support from executive leadership and Board members for donor meetings.
Remote position within the United States.
Approximately 30% travel expected.
Full-time, exempt position.

Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

new_jobs.title: Director of Development & Production, Digital Programming
new_jobs.description:
The Director of Development & Production is a senior creative leader responsible for the development, production, and execution of premium digital-first content across Lifestyle, Food & Travel, and Entertainment. This role oversees content from concept through delivery while driving creative innovation, production excellence, and audience growth across YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and emerging digital platforms.

The ideal candidate is an experienced creative producer with a passion for storytelling, a proven ability to develop original franchises and recurring series, and an enthusiasm for Food, Travel, and Entertainment programming. They understand how to create compelling, platform-native content that grows audiences, attracts brand partners, and elevates an established media brand.

Working closely with executive leadership, editorial, audience development, and sales teams, the Director of Development & Production will lead creative development, oversee production operations, mentor production teams, and ensure every project meets the highest editorial and production standards.

Responsibilities

Creative Development & Strategy

Lead the creative development of original digital series, recurring franchises, specials, and branded content initiatives for growing digital editorial brands including @AmazingAmericaTV and @PauseRewind.
Identify emerging audience trends, platform opportunities, and storytelling formats that support audience growth and business objectives.
Generate, pitch, and develop new programming concepts while evolving existing series with fresh creative approaches.
Create series treatments, story outlines, mood boards, production decks, and presentation materials for internal stakeholders and external partners.
Partner with leadership to build and maintain a robust content development pipeline aligned with editorial priorities and commercial opportunities.

Production Leadership

Oversee all productions from greenlight through final delivery across multiple platforms and formats.
Direct studio and field productions, providing clear creative vision to crews, producers, editors, and on-camera talent.
Manage creative execution throughout pre-production, production, post-production, and final approval.
Review and approve creative materials including treatments, scripts, casting recommendations, production schedules, budgets, graphics, music, rough cuts, fine cuts, and final deliverables.
Establish production workflows and best practices that improve efficiency while maintaining exceptional creative quality.

Team Leadership

Mentor producers, coordinators, freelance talent, editors, and production partners.
Foster a collaborative, creative culture focused on innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Manage multiple concurrent productions while balancing priorities, deadlines, budgets, and available resources.
Facilitate creative brainstorms with Editorial, Audience Development, and Sales teams to maximize content performance.

Audience Growth & Optimization

Collaborate with Audience Development and Analytics teams to leverage performance insights and optimize future content.
Maintain a deep understanding of platform algorithms, viewer behavior, and evolving digital consumption habits.
Champion experimentation with new storytelling techniques, production technologies, creators, and distribution strategies.

Brand Partnerships & Business Development

Work closely with branded content and sales teams to develop premium sponsorship opportunities that seamlessly integrate advertiser objectives while maintaining editorial integrity.
Cultivate relationships within the tourism, hospitality, culinary, lifestyle, and entertainment industries to identify new content and partnership opportunities.
Represent the company during partner meetings, industry events, production shoots, and creative presentations.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Film, Television, Digital Media, Marketing, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
7+ years of experience developing and producing original digital content for major media brands, publishers, production companies, or digital platforms.
Demonstrated leadership experience managing creative production teams and overseeing multiple concurrent productions.
Professional experience and genuine enthusiasm for creating Lifestyle, Food & Travel, and Entertainment content.
Proven success developing and launching original digital video series that drive audience engagement and growth.
Extensive experience overseeing productions from concept through post-production across YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, FAST, streaming, and emerging platforms.
Strong creative judgment with experience providing feedback across every stage of development, production, and editorial review.
Experience directing both studio and field productions, working with talent, creators, celebrities, and non-professional hosts.
Strong understanding of branded content, sponsorship integrations, and advertiser collaboration.
Exceptional organizational, communication, and project management skills.

Preferred

Experience developing creator-led programming and influencer collaborations.
Familiarity with production management software, digital asset management systems, and content performance analytics.
Experience managing production budgets, vendor negotiations, and resource planning.

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

new_jobs.description:
Company Description
Tolbert Realty LLC is a real estate company focused on providing reliable, client-centered property services in a dynamic and competitive market. The organization emphasizes transparency, responsiveness, and long-term relationships with clients and partners. Team members collaborate to streamline processes, improve service quality, and support sustainable growth. Tolbert Realty LLC values professionalism, accountability, and continuous improvement, offering opportunities to contribute meaningfully to operational and strategic initiatives.
Role Description
The Director of Operations at Tolbert Realty LLC is a full-time, remote role responsible for overseeing daily business operations and ensuring efficient, consistent workflows across the organization. This position manages operational processes, develops and implements policies, and monitors performance metrics to support business goals and regulatory compliance. The Director of Operations will coordinate cross-functional teams, optimize resource allocation, and collaborate with leadership on strategic planning, budgeting, and forecasting. Day-to-day responsibilities include supervising team performance, resolving operational issues, improving customer service practices, and identifying opportunities for process enhancements and cost savings. The role also involves maintaining documentation, supporting technology and system adoption, and fostering a culture of accountability, communication, and continuous improvement.
Qualifications

Strong Operations Management skills, including experience designing, implementing, and refining processes to improve efficiency and scalability.
Demonstrated Analytical Skills to interpret data, track key performance indicators, and drive data-informed decisions.
Proven Team Management abilities, including leading remote teams, coaching staff, and managing cross-functional collaboration.
Experience with Budgeting, financial oversight, and cost control to support sustainable growth and operational stability.
Commitment to high-quality Customer Service, with the ability to support client-focused standards and resolve escalated issues.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong organizational and time management capabilities.
Proficiency with common business software, collaboration tools, and basic CRM or real estate platforms.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations Management, or a related field; equivalent experience in operations leadership may be considered.
Prior experience in real estate, property management, or a service-oriented business environment is preferred.
